/**
 * This text is inserted into the EXISTING /api/me/permissions GET handler
 * only in the disposable GitHub Actions checkout. Not imported by the app.
 * The production route source remains unchanged at the end of this test.
 */
  if (process.env.ALT0810C31_EPHEMERAL === '1') {
    const env = process.env;
    if (env.CI !== 'true' || env.GITHUB_ACTIONS !== 'true' ||
        env.RUNNER_OS !== 'Linux' || env.PGHOST !== '127.0.0.1' ||
        env.PGPORT !== '5432' || env.PGDATABASE !== 'vigia_alt081_ci' ||
        env.DATABASE_URL || env.RLS_DATABASE_URL) {
      return NextResponse.json({error:'CI_ONLY'}, {status:503});
    }
    const {Client} = await import('pg');
    const {verifySession,SESSION_COOKIE} = await import('@/lib/session');
    const {authorizedTenantRead} = await import('@/lib/tenant/alt0810c30-transactional-read');
    const cookieHeader = request.headers.get('cookie') ?? '';
    const cookieValue = cookieHeader.split(';').map(v=>v.trim())
      .find(v=>v.startsWith(SESSION_COOKIE+'='))?.slice(SESSION_COOKIE.length+1);
    const session = verifySession(cookieValue);
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({error:'UNAUTHENTICATED'}, {status:401});
    const db = new Client({
      host:'127.0.0.1',port:5432,database:'vigia_alt081_ci',
      user:'vigia_ci',password:'isolated_ci_only',
      options:'-c search_path=alt0810c31_http',
    });
    await db.connect();
    try {
      // This is a hint from the signed principal, NOT trust in query parameters.
      // The transactional gate rechecks membership/session/contract under locks.
      const member = await db.query(
        'SELECT tenant_id FROM alt0810c31_http.memberships WHERE user_id=$1 ORDER BY tenant_id',
        [session.userId]);
      if (member.rows.length !== 1)
        return NextResponse.json({error:'FORBIDDEN'}, {status:403});
      const tenantId = Number(member.rows[0].tenant_id);
      const decision = await authorizedTenantRead({
        db,cookie:cookieValue,tenantId,featureKey:'reports_weekly',
        readerRole:'alt0810c31_reader',
        read:async tx=>{
          const records = await tx.query(
            'SELECT id FROM alt0810c31_http.evidence ORDER BY id');
          return records.rows.map(r=>Number(r.id));
        },
      });
      if (decision.status!==200)
        return NextResponse.json({error:decision.status===401?'UNAUTHENTICATED':'FORBIDDEN'},
          {status:decision.status,headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
      return NextResponse.json({
        permissions:{tenantId},features:['reports_weekly'],
        scopedEvidenceIds:decision.data,
      },{headers:{'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
    } finally {
      await db.end();
    }
  }
